variants.headline: Home world answers colony's petition
variants.body: The home world has answered the colony's petition. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Petition receives an answer
variants.body: The colony has received an answer to its petition from the home world. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
